Sub Initialize
	On Error Goto ERR_HANDLE
	Dim objBaseDBInfo As clsBaseDBInfo
	Dim objDocElement As clsDocElement
	Dim objInputInfo As clsInputInfo
	Dim strSearchMacro As String
	Dim intReturn As Integer
	Dim blnSelectFlg As Boolean
	Dim blnLoopFlg As Boolean
	Do
		blnSelectFlg = False
		intReturn = fncDataPreparation( strSearchMacro, _
		objBaseDBInfo, objDocElement, objInputInfo )
		Select Case intReturn
		Case 0
			strSearchMacro = ""
		Case Else
			Exit Sub
		End Select
		Do
			blnLoopFlg = False
			intReturn = fncMain( objBaseDBInfo, objDocElement, objInputInfo )
			Select Case intReturn
			Case 0
				blnLoopFlg = objInputInfo.RepetitionFlg
			Case 1
				If objInputInfo.RepetitionFlg = False Then
					Exit Sub
				Elseif Msgbox( "連続入力を終了しますか？", 4+32+256, "連続入力確認" ) = 7 Then
					blnLoopFlg = True
				Else
					Exit Sub
				End If
			Case 2
				blnSelectFlg = True
				strSearchMacro = objInputInfo.InputValue
			Case 4
				blnLoopFlg = True
			Case Else
				Exit Sub
			End Select
			Call objInputInfo.InitialSet( )
		Loop While blnLoopFlg = True
	Loop While blnSelectFlg = True
	Exit Sub
ERR_HANDLE:
	Call OnErrorMsgDisp( "Initializeイベント", Erl, Err, Error$ )
	Exit Sub
End Sub
Function fncDataPreparation( strSearchMacro As String, _
objBaseDBInfo As clsBaseDBInfo, objDocElement As clsDocElement, _
objInputInfo As clsInputInfo ) As Integer
	On Error Goto ERR_HANDLE
	fncDataPreparation = -1
	Dim strTitle As String
	Dim strMsg As String
	Dim intReturn As Integer
	Dim lngSelectCnt As Long
	If objBaseDBInfo Is Nothing Then
		Set objBaseDBInfo = New clsBaseDBInfo
		Select Case objBaseDBInfo.ACLLevel
		Case ACLLEVEL_MANAGER
		Case ACLLEVEL_EDITOR , ACLLEVEL_DESIGNER
			If  Isnull(Arraygetindex(objBaseDBInfo.UserRoles, "[DATACHANGE]", 1) ) = False Then
			Else
				Msgbox "使用する権限がありません。" , 16 , "使用不可"
				fncDataPreparation = 1
				Exit Function
			End If
		Case Else
			Msgbox "使用する権限がありません。" , 16 , "使用不可"
			fncDataPreparation = 1
			Exit Function
		End Select
	End If
	With objBaseDBInfo
		Call  .GetSelectDoc( strSearchMacro )
		lngSelectCnt =  .SelectDocCnt
	End With
	If strSearchMacro = "" Then
		Select Case lngSelectCnt
		Case 0
			Msgbox "文書を選択してから実行してください。" , 48 , "対象文書未選択"
			fncDataPreparation = 1
			Exit Function
		Case 1
		Case Else
			If Msgbox( "現在、" & Cstr( lngSelectCnt ) & "件の文書を選択しています･･･" & Chr(13)_
			& "処理を続行してもよろしいですか？", 4+32, "変更件数確認" ) = 7 Then
				Msgbox "データ変更を取りやめました。" , 48 , "変更中止"
				fncDataPreparation = 1
				Exit Function
			End If
		End Select
	Else
		Select Case lngSelectCnt
		Case 0
			Call objBaseDBInfo.GetSelectDoc( "" )
			lngSelectCnt = objBaseDBInfo.SelectDocCnt
			Msgbox "条件に該当する文書が見つかりませんでした。" & Chr(13) _
			& "代わりに選択文書" & Cstr( lngSelectCnt ) & "件を処理対象にします。" , 48 , "対象文書なし"
		Case Else
			Msgbox Cstr( lngSelectCnt ) & "件の文書が見つかりました。" & Chr(13) _
			& "抽出した文書を処理対象にします。" , 64 , "対象文書抽出"
		End Select
	End If
	Call objBaseDBInfo.GetFirstDoc( )
	If objDocElement Is Nothing Then
	Else
		Delete objDocElement
	End If
	Set objDocElement = New clsDocElement( objBaseDBInfo.FirstDoc )
	Call objDocElement.GetFList( )
	If objInputInfo Is Nothing Then
		Set objInputInfo = New clsInputInfo
	Else
	End If
	strTitle = "変更フィールド指定≪選択文書数" & Cstr( lngSelectCnt ) & "件≫"
	strMsg = {データ変更を行うフィールド名を入力してください。} & Chr(13) _
	& {また、特殊操作のヘルプを参照する場合は「?」を入力してください。}
	Call objInputInfo.FNameInfo( strTitle, strMsg, "", objDocElement.listFName )
	fncDataPreparation = 0
	Exit Function
ERR_HANDLE:
	Call OnErrorMsgDisp( "fncDataPreparation関数", Erl, Err, Error$ )
	fncDataPreparation = -1
	Exit Function
End Function
Function fncMain( objBaseDBInfo As clsBaseDBInfo, objDocElement As clsDocElement, _
objInputInfo As clsInputInfo ) As Integer
	On Error Goto ERR_HANDLE
	fncMain = -1
	Dim objDataSetPreparation As clsDataSetPreparation
	Dim intReturn As Integer
	intReturn = fncSelectAct( objInputInfo )
	Select Case intReturn
	Case 0
	Case 1
		fncMain = 1
		Exit Function
	Case Else
		fncMain = -1
		Exit Function
	End Select
	intReturn = fncExistDataDecision( objDocElement, objInputInfo )
	Select Case intReturn
	Case 0
	Case 1
		fncMain = 1
		Exit Function
	Case 2
		fncMain = 4
		Exit Function
	Case Else
		fncMain = -1
		Exit Function
	End Select
	intReturn = fncDataTypeSelect( objInputInfo )
	Select Case intReturn
	Case 0
	Case 1
		fncMain = 1
		Exit Function
	Case Else
		fncMain = -1
		Exit Function
	End Select
	intReturn = fncSetDataInput( objInputInfo, objDataSetPreparation )
	Select Case intReturn
	Case 0
	Case 1
		fncMain = 1
		Exit Function
	Case 2
		fncMain = 2
		Exit Function
	Case Else
		fncMain = -1
		Exit Function
	End Select
	intReturn = fncInputDataReplace( objDataSetPreparation, objBaseDBInfo )
	Select Case intReturn
	Case 0
	Case 1
		fncMain = 3
		Exit Function
	Case Else
		fncMain = -1
		Exit Function
	End Select
	fncMain = 0
	Exit Function
ERR_HANDLE:
	Call OnErrorMsgDisp( "fncMain関数", Erl, Err, Error$ )
	fncMain = -1
	Exit Function
End Function
Function fncSelectAct( objInputInfo As clsInputInfo ) As Integer
	On Error Goto ERR_HANDLE
	Dim strFName As String
	Dim intReturn As Integer
	Dim blnInputFlg As Boolean
	fncSelectAct = -1
	Do
		blnInputFlg = False
		intReturn = objInputInfo.fncPromptSet( 1 )
		If intReturn < 1 Then
			Msgbox "データ変更を取りやめました。" , 48 , "変更中止"
			fncSelectAct = 1
			Exit Function
		Else
			strFName = Strconv( objInputInfo.FName, 8 )
		End If
		Select Case strFName
		Case "&"
			objInputInfo.RepetitionFlg = True
			blnInputFlg = True
			Msgbox "連続入力可能に設定しました。", 64, "連続入力"
		Case "%"
			objInputInfo.LogFlg = True
			blnInputFlg = True
			Msgbox "ログ書出し設定にしました。", 64, "ログ設定"
		Case "/"
			objInputInfo.AllSetFlg = True
			blnInputFlg = True
			Msgbox "一括処理可能に設定しました。", 64, "一括処理設定"
		Case "@"
			If objInputInfo.AllSetFlg = True Then
				blnInputFlg = True
				Msgbox "一括処理を設定した場合、" & Chr(13)_
				& "式の実行はできません。", 48, "INPUT ERROR"
			Else
			End If
		Case "!A"
			If Msgbox( "文書を増殖します。" & Chr(13) & "よろしいですか？", 4+32+256, "入力確認" ) = 7 Then
				blnInputFlg = True
				Msgbox "再度入力してください。", 64, "入力確認"
			Else
			End If
		Case "!C"
			If Msgbox( "文書をコピーします。" & Chr(13) & "よろしいですか？", 4+32+256, "入力確認" ) = 7 Then
				blnInputFlg = True
				Msgbox "再度入力してください。", 64, "入力確認"
			Else
			End If
		Case "!D"
			If Msgbox( "文書を削除します。" & Chr(13) & "よろしいですか？", 4+32+256, "入力確認" ) = 7 Then
				blnInputFlg = True
				Msgbox "再度入力してください。", 64, "入力確認"
			Else
			End If
		Case "!M"
			If Msgbox( "文書を移動します。" & Chr(13) & "よろしいですか？", 4+32+256, "入力確認" ) = 7 Then
				blnInputFlg = True
				Msgbox "再度入力してください。", 64, "入力確認"
			Else
			End If
		Case "!R"
			If objInputInfo.AllSetFlg = True Then
				blnInputFlg = True
				Msgbox "一括処理を設定した場合、" & Chr(13)_
				& "文書の更新はできません。", 48, "INPUT ERROR"
			Elseif Msgbox( "文書を更新します。" & Chr(13) & "よろしいですか？", 4+32+256, "入力確認" ) = 7 Then
				blnInputFlg = True
				Msgbox "再度入力してください。", 64, "入力確認"
			Else
			End If
		Case "?"
			blnInputFlg = True
			Msgbox SelectReturnString("FIELDNAME_HELP_MESSAGE"), 64, "特殊操作ヘルプ"
		Case Else
			If Left( strFName, 1 ) = ";" Then
				blnInputFlg = True
				Msgbox "はじめにセミコロンは入力できません。", 48, "INPUT ERROR"
			Elseif Right( strFName, 1 ) = ";" Then
				blnInputFlg = True
				Msgbox "最後にセミコロンは入力できません。", 48, "INPUT ERROR"
			Elseif Instr( 1, strFName, ";;", 0 ) > 0 Then
				blnInputFlg = True
				Msgbox "連続したセミコロンは入力できません。", 48, "INPUT ERROR"
			Elseif ( objInputInfo.AllSetFlg = True ) And ( Instr( 1, strFName, ";", 0 ) > 0 ) Then
				blnInputFlg = True
				Msgbox "一括処理を設定した場合、" & Chr(13)_
				& "複数フィールドに対して処理できません。", 48, "INPUT ERROR"
			Else
			End If
		End Select
	Loop While blnInputFlg = True
	fncSelectAct = 0
	Exit Function
ERR_HANDLE:
	Call OnErrorMsgDisp( "fncSelectAct関数", Erl, Err, Error$ )
	fncSelectAct = -1
	Exit Function
End Function
Function fncExistDataDecision( objDocElement As clsDocElement, _
objInputInfo As clsInputInfo ) As Integer
	On Error Goto ERR_HANDLE
	fncExistDataDecision = -1
	Dim varSetDefault As Variant
	Dim varSetSubDefault As Variant
	Dim varSetTypeDefault As Variant
	Dim varFName As Variant
	Dim strFName As String
	Dim strTitle As String
	Dim strMsg As String
	Dim strData As String
	Dim strDefault As String
	Dim strSubDefault As String
	Dim strSelectMain As String
	Dim strTmp As String
	Dim strSubType As String
	Dim strType As String
	Dim strTypeElement As String
	strFName = Strconv(objInputInfo.FName, 8)
	Select Case strFName
	Case "@", "!A", "!C", "!D", "!M", "!R", "*"
		fncExistDataDecision = 0
		Exit Function
	Case Else
	End Select
	varFName = Split( objInputInfo.FName, ";" )
	If Ubound(varFName) > 0 Then
		Call MakeMsg(objDocElement, varFName)
		Call objInputInfo.SetOldProperty( "", "" )
		strTitle = "☆フィールド名：『" & objInputInfo.FName & "』"
		strMsg = SelectReturnString( "REPLACE_FIELD_MESSAGE" )
		strDefault = "S"
		strSelectMain = "S/D/N/V/R/E/S[N]/S[NR]/S[NA]/Z"
		strSubDefault =  "V-D"
	Else
		Call objDocElement.GetFInfo( objInputInfo.FName, 0 )
		If objDocElement.FValue Is Nothing Then
			Msgbox "フィールドが存在しません。" & Chr(13) & "データを新規作成します。" , 64 , "データ作成"
			strTitle = "☆フィールド名：『" & objInputInfo.FName & "』"
			strMsg = SelectReturnString( "NEW_FIELD_MESSAGE" )
			strDefault = "S"
			If objInputInfo.AllSetFlg = False Then
				strSelectMain = "S/D/N/V/R/S[N]/S[NR]/S[NA]/Z"
			Else
				strSelectMain = "S/D/N/V/Z"
			End If
			strSubDefault =  "V-D"
		Else
			With objDocElement
				Call  .GetFInfo( objInputInfo.FName, 1 )
				strDefault = fncExistType(  .FProperty,  .FValue )
			End With
			strType = fncSeparateProperty( strDefault, 0 )
			strTypeElement = fncSeparateProperty( strDefault, 1 )
			If objInputInfo.AllSetFlg = False Then
			Else
				Select Case strDefault
				Case "S", "D", "N", "V", "V-D"
				Case Else
					fncExistDataDecision = 2
					Msgbox SelectReturnString("ALLSET_ERROR_MESSAGE"), 48 , "一括処理不可"
					Exit Function
				End Select
			End If
			Select Case strType
			Case "R", "V-R"
				If objDocElement.AttachList( 0 ) <> "" Then
					Forall tmpFile In objDocElement.AttachList
						strTmp = strTmp & "       ⇒" & tmpFile & Chr(13)
					End Forall
					Msgbox "指定したフィールドに以下のファイルが保存されています。" & Chr(13)&Chr(13)_
					& strTmp & Chr(13) & SelectReturnString( "FILE_CHECK_MESSAGE" ), 64, "ファイルの確認"
				End If
			Case Else
			End Select
			If strType = "R" Then
				strData = objDocElement.FValue.GetUnFormattedText()
			Else
				strData = objDocElement.FValue.text
			End If
			Call objInputInfo.SetOldProperty( strDefault, strData )
			If Len(strData) > 50 Then
				strTmp = Left(strData, 50) & "･･･"
			Else
				strTmp = strData
			End If
			strTitle = "☆フィールド名：『" & objInputInfo.FName & "』    ★値：『" & strTmp & "』"
			strMsg = SelectReturnString("REPLACE_FIELD_MESSAGE")
			If objInputInfo.AllSetFlg = False Then
				strSelectMain = "S/D/N/V/R/E/S[N]/S[NR]/S[NA]"
				If strType = "S" Then
					strSelectMain = strSelectMain & "/U/A/C"
				Elseif strType = "R" Then
					strSelectMain = strSelectMain & "/A"
				Else
				End If
				strSelectMain = strSelectMain & "/Z/" & strDefault
				Select Case strType
				Case "S","D","N","V","R"
					strSubDefault =  "V-D"
				Case Else
					strSubDefault = strDefault
				End Select
			Else
				strSelectMain = "S/D/N/V/Z/" & strDefault
				strSubDefault =  "V-D"
			End If
		End If
	End If
	varSetDefault = KeywordListReturn( strDefault )
	Call objInputInfo.MainInfo( strTitle, strMsg, varSetDefault(0), KeywordListReturn( strSelectMain ) )
	strMsg = SelectReturnString("SPECIAL_ELEMENT_MESSAGE")
	If objInputInfo.AllSetFlg = False Then
		strSelectMain = "V-D/V-R/S[NRA]/V[NRA]/V[N]/V[NR]/V[NA]/F"
	Else
		strSelectMain = "V-D"
	End If
	varSetSubDefault = KeywordListReturn( strSubDefault )
	Call objInputInfo.SpecialInfo( strTitle, strMsg, varSetSubDefault(0), KeywordListReturn( strSelectMain ) )
	If strTypeElement <> "" Then
		varSetTypeDefault = KeywordListReturn("[" & strTypeElement & "]")
	Else
		varSetTypeDefault = KeywordListReturn("S")
	End If
	strTitle = "◆設定する型･･･【属性変更】  ☆フィールド名：『" & objInputInfo.FName & "』"
	strMsg = "設定する型を選択してください。"
	Call objInputInfo.ElementInfo( strTitle, strMsg, varSetTypeDefault(0), KeywordListReturn( "S/[N]/[NR]/[NA]/[NRA]" ) )
	fncExistDataDecision = 0
	Exit Function
ERR_HANDLE:
	Call OnErrorMsgDisp( "fncExistDataDecision関数", Erl, Err, Error$ )
	fncExistDataDecision = -1
	Exit Function
End Function
Function fncDataTypeSelect( objInputInfo As clsInputInfo ) As Integer
	On Error Goto ERR_HANDLE
	Dim varSelect As Variant
	Dim strType As String
	Dim strTypeElement As String
	Dim strTitle As String
	Dim strMsg As String
	Dim strData As String
	Dim strKata As String
	Dim intReturn As Integer
	Dim blnJudge As Boolean
	fncDataTypeSelect = -1
	strType = Strconv(objInputInfo.FName, 8)
	Select Case strType
	Case "@","!A","!C","!D","!M","!R","*"
		objInputInfo.FProperty = strType
		blnJudge = True
	Case Else
		blnJudge = False
	End Select
	Do While blnJudge = False
		blnJudge = True
		strType = ""
		strTypeElement = ""
		intReturn = objInputInfo.fncPromptSet(2)
		If intReturn < 1  Then
			fncDataTypeSelect = 1
			Msgbox "データ変更を取りやめました。" , 48 , "変更中止"
			Exit Function
		Else
			strType = fncSeparateProperty( objInputInfo.FProperty, 0 )
		End If
		Select Case strType
		Case "Z"
			intReturn = objInputInfo.fncPromptSet(3)
		Case "C"
			intReturn = objInputInfo.fncPromptSet(5)
		Case Else
		End Select
		If intReturn < 1  Then
			fncDataTypeSelect = 1
			Msgbox "データ変更を取りやめました。" , 48 , "変更中止"
			Exit Function
		Else
			With objInputInfo
				strType = fncSeparateProperty(  .FProperty, 0 )
				strTypeElement = fncSeparateProperty(  .FProperty, 1 )
			End With
		End If
		strKata = fncTypeReturn( strType, strTypeElement )
		Select Case strType
		Case "R","A"
			If ( strType = "R" ) Or _
			(( strType = "A" ) And ( fncSeparateProperty( objInputInfo.FOldProperty, 0 ) = "R" )) Then
				Msgbox SelectReturnString("RICHFIELD_HELP_MESSAGE"), 0, _
				"「Alt」+「Print Screen」でヘルプ画面を一時的に画像ファイルに表示してください。"
			Else
			End If
		Case "V","V-D","V-R"
			If Msgbox(strKata & "を設定します。" & Chr(13)_
			& "よろしいですか？", 4+32, "NULL設定確認" ) = 7 Then
				Msgbox "設定したい型を再度入力してください。" , 48 , "変更中止"
				blnJudge = False
			End If
		Case "E"
			If Msgbox("フィールドごと消去します。" & Chr(13)_
			& "よろしいですか？", 4+32, "フィールド消去確認" ) = 7 Then
				Msgbox "設定したい型を再度入力してください。" , 48 , "変更中止"
				blnJudge = False
			End If
		Case Else
		End Select
	Loop
	Select Case strType
	Case "S","N","D","R","A","F","U"
		strTitle = "◆設定する型･･･" & strKata & "  ☆フィールド名：『" & objInputInfo.FName & "』"
	Case "@"
		strTitle = "◆式実行"
	Case "!A"
		strTitle = "◆文書増殖"
	Case "!C"
		strTitle = "◆文書コピー"
	Case "!M"
		strTitle = "◆文書移動"
	Case "!R"
		strTitle = "◆文書更新"
	Case "*"
		strTitle = "◆文書抽出"
	Case Else
		strTitle = ""
	End Select
	Select Case strType
	Case "S","N","D"
		strMsg = SelectReturnString( "SET_NORMALFIELD_MESSAGE" )
		If fncSeparateProperty( objInputInfo.FProperty, 2 ) = "S" Then
			strMsg = strMsg & Chr(13) & SelectReturnString( "SET_STRINGFIELD_ADDMESSAGE" )
		End If
	Case "R"
		strMsg =  "フィールドに設定する値を入力してください。(キャンセルで中止)" & Chr(13)_
		& SelectReturnString( "SET_RICHFIELD_MESSAGE" )
	Case "U"
		strMsg = SelectReturnString( "SET_UPDATEFIELD_MESSAGE" )
	Case "A"
		strMsg = "フィールドに追加する値を入力してください。(キャンセルで中止)" & Chr(13)
		If fncSeparateProperty( objInputInfo.FOldProperty, 0 ) = "R" Then
			strMsg = strMsg & SelectReturnString( "SET_RICHFIELD_MESSAGE" )
		Else
			strMsg = strMsg & SelectReturnString( "SET_STRINGFIELD_ADDMESSAGE" ) & Chr(13)_
			& SelectReturnString( "SET_APPENDFIELD_MESSAGE" )
		End If
	Case "F"
		strMsg = SelectReturnString( "INPUT_FORMAT_MESSAGE" )
	Case "@"
		strMsg = SelectReturnString( "SET_MACRO_MESSAGE" )
	Case "!A"
		strMsg = "文書を増殖する倍数を入力してください。(キャンセルで中止)" & Chr(13) _
		& "対象文書が複数の場合は積算になります。"
	Case "!C","!M"
		strMsg = "文書反映先DBのサーバ名、ファイルパスを" & Chr(13) _
		& "セミコロン( ; )区切りで入力してください。(キャンセルで中止)" & Chr(13) _
		& "また、カレントDBを指定する場合はセミコロンのみ入力してください。"
	Case "*"
		strMsg = {文書抽出条件を入力してください。(キャンセルで中止)} & Chr(13) _
		& {・・・(ex) 『SELECT Form = "Memo"』}
	Case Else
		strMsg = ""
	End Select
	strData = objInputInfo.FOldValue
	Select Case strType
	Case "S","R","U","A","F"
		Call LineTabChange( 0, strData )
	Case "@"
		strData = "実行する式を入力してください。"
	Case "!A"
		strData = "1"
	Case "!C","!M"
		strData = "サーバ名、ファイルパスを入力してください。"
	Case "*"
		strData = "文書を抽出する式を入力してください。"
	Case "D","N"
	Case Else
		strData = ""
	End Select
	Call objInputInfo.InputInfo(strTitle, strMsg, strData)
	fncDataTypeSelect = 0
	Exit Function
ERR_HANDLE:
	Call OnErrorMsgDisp( "fncDataTypeSelect関数", Erl, Err, Error$ )
	fncDataTypeSelect = -1
	Exit Function
End Function
Function fncSetDataInput( objInputInfo As clsInputInfo, _
objDataSetPreparation As clsDataSetPreparation ) As Integer
	On Error Goto ERR_HANDLE
	Dim vInputEndFlag As Variant
	Dim varResult As Variant
	Dim strData As String
	Dim strType As String
	Dim intInputSize As Integer
	Dim intCustomFlg As Integer
	Dim intReturn As Integer
	fncSetDataInput = -1
	strType = fncSeparateProperty( objInputInfo.FProperty, 0 )
	Select Case strType
	Case "S","N","D","R","U","A","F","@","*","!A","!C","!M"
		Do
			vInputEndFlag = True
			intReturn = objInputInfo.fncPromptSet(4)
			If intReturn < 1 Then
				fncSetDataInput = 1
				Msgbox "データ変更を取りやめました。" , 48 , "変更中止"
				Exit Function
			Else
			End If
			strData = objInputInfo.InputValue
			intInputSize = InputDataByteCheck(strData)
			If intInputSize > 253 Then
				Msgbox SelectReturnString("INPUT_SIZE_ERROR_MESSAGE")_
				& "『" & strData & "』", 16, "INPUT ERROR"
				objInputInfo.InputInfoDefault = strData
				vInputEndFlag = False
			Elseif fncInputCheck( strType, strData ) = False Then
				Msgbox SelectReturnString("INPUT_ERROR_MESSAGE"), 16, "INPUT ERROR"
				objInputInfo.InputInfoDefault = strData
				vInputEndFlag = False
			Else
				If strType = "*" Then
					fncSetDataInput = 2
					Exit Function
				Else
					intCustomFlg = fncInputDataCustomize( objInputInfo, objDataSetPreparation )
					Select Case intCustomFlg
					Case 0
					Case 1
						vInputEndFlag = False
						objInputInfo.InputInfoDefault = strData
					Case Else
						fncSetDataInput = -1
						Exit Function
					End Select
				End If
			End If
		Loop While vInputEndFlag = False
	Case Else
		intCustomFlg = fncInputDataCustomize( objInputInfo, objDataSetPreparation )
		Select Case intCustomFlg
		Case 0
		Case 1
			fncSetDataInput = 1
			Exit Function
		Case Else
			fncSetDataInput = -1
			Exit Function
		End Select
	End Select
	fncSetDataInput = 0
	Exit Function
ERR_HANDLE:
	Call OnErrorMsgDisp( "fncSetDataInput関数", Erl, Err, Error$ )
	fncSetDataInput = -1
	Exit Function
End Function
Function fncInputDataCustomize( objInputInfo As clsInputInfo, _
objDataSetPreparation As clsDataSetPreparation ) As Integer
	On Error Goto ERR_HANDLE
	Dim dbCopy As NotesDatabase
	Dim varResult As Variant
	Dim varRet As Variant
	Dim strData As String
	Dim strType As String
	Dim strElement As String
	Dim blnRichSet As Boolean
	fncInputDataCustomize = -1
	strData = objInputInfo.InputValue
	strType = fncSeparateProperty( objInputInfo.FProperty, 0 )
	strElement = fncSeparateProperty( objInputInfo.FProperty, 1 )
	Set objDataSetPreparation = New clsDataSetPreparation
	Select Case strType
	Case "!A"
		Call objDataSetPreparation.GetCopyDB( ";" )
	Case "!C","!M"
		Call objDataSetPreparation.GetCopyDB( objInputInfo.InputValue )
		Set dbCopy = objDataSetPreparation.CopyDB
		If dbCopy Is Nothing Then
			Msgbox "指定のDBが取得できません。", 48 , "DB取得エラー"
			fncInputDataCustomize = 1
			Exit Function
			Elseif Msgbox( "文書反映先は以下のDBでよろしいですか？" & Chr(13)&Chr(13) _
			& "タイトル：" & dbCopy.Title & Chr(13) & _
			"サーバ名：" & dbCopy.Server & Chr(13) & _
		"ファイルパス：" & dbCopy.FilePath, 4+32+256, "反映先確認" ) = 7 Then
			fncInputDataCustomize = 1
			Exit Function
		Elseif Not dbCopy.CurrentAccessLevel = ACLLEVEL_MANAGER Then
			Msgbox "コピー先DBに管理者の権限がないため、" & Chr(13) _
			& "文書を反映できません。" , 16 , "権限不足"
			fncInputDataCustomize = 1
			Exit Function
		Else
		End If
	Case Else
	End Select
	Select Case strType
	Case "!D","!M"
		varRet = Evaluate( {@UserAccess( @DbName ; [DELETEDOCUMENTS] )} )
		If ( varRet(0) <> "1" ) Then
			Msgbox "文書を削除する権限がありません。" , 16 , "権限不足"
			fncInputDataCustomize = 1
			Exit Function
		Else
		End If
	Case Else
	End Select
	Select Case strType
	Case "!A"
		If Msgbox( "対象文書を" & Cstr(Clng(objInputInfo.InputValue)) _
		& "倍にして追加しますがよろしいですか？", 4+32+256, "倍数確認" ) = 7 Then
			fncInputDataCustomize = 1
			Exit Function
		Else
		End If
	Case Else
	End Select
	Select Case strType
	Case "S","V"
		If strElement = "" Then
			Call LineTabChange( 1, strData )
		Else
		End If
		varResult = fncArrayCreaData( 0, strData )
		Call objDataSetPreparation.SetInputData( varResult, strElement )
	Case "N"
		varResult = fncArrayCreaData( 1, strData )
		Call objDataSetPreparation.SetInputData( varResult, "" )
	Case "D","V-D"
		varResult = fncArrayCreaData( 2, strData )
		Call objDataSetPreparation.SetInputData( varResult, "" )
	Case "R","V-R"
		Call LineTabChange( 1, strData )
		Call objDataSetPreparation.CreateRichData( varResult )
		If RichReplace( strData, varResult ) = False Then
			fncInputDataCustomize = 1
			Exit Function
		Else
		End If
	Case "U","F"
		Call LineTabChange( 1, strData )
	Case "A"
		Call LineTabChange( 1, strData )
		If fncSeparateProperty( objInputInfo.FOldProperty, 0 ) = "R" Then
			Call objDataSetPreparation.CreateRichData( varResult )
			If RichReplace( strData, varResult ) = False Then
				fncInputDataCustomize = 1
				Exit Function
			Else
			End If
		Else
			varResult = fncArrayCreaData( 0, strData )
			Call objDataSetPreparation.SetInputData( varResult, "" )
		End If
	Case "!A"
		Call objDataSetPreparation.SetInputData( Clng(strData), "" )
	Case Else
		Call objDataSetPreparation.SetInputData( "", "" )
	End Select
	Select Case strType
	Case "@","!A","!C","!D","!M","!R"
		objDataSetPreparation.FName = ""
	Case Else
		objDataSetPreparation.FName = objInputInfo.FName
	End Select
	Select Case strType
	Case "E","U","F","@","!A","!C","!D","!M","!R"
		Call objDataSetPreparation.SetOperateType( strType, strData )
	Case "C"
		Call objDataSetPreparation.SetOperateType( strType, objInputInfo.ChangeProperty )
	Case Else
		Call objDataSetPreparation.SetOperateType( strType, strElement )
	End Select
	Select Case strType
	Case "@","!A","!C","!D","!M","!R"
		Call objDataSetPreparation.LogInfo( False, "" )
	Case Else
		Call objDataSetPreparation.LogInfo( objInputInfo.LogFlg, objInputInfo.LogPath )
	End Select
	objDataSetPreparation.AllSetFlg = objInputInfo.AllSetFlg
	fncInputDataCustomize = 0
	Exit Function
ERR_HANDLE:
	fncInputDataCustomize = -1
	Call OnErrorMsgDisp( "fncInputDataCustomize関数", Erl, Err, Error$ )
	Exit Function
End Function
Function fncInputDataReplace( objDataSetPreparation As clsDataSetPreparation, _
objBaseDBInfo As clsBaseDBInfo ) As Integer
	On Error Goto ERR_HANDLE
	Dim docTarget As NotesDocument
	Dim lngDcCnt As Long
	Dim lngLoop As Long
	Dim lngCopyCnt As Long
	Dim lngLargeCnt As Long
	Dim lngCopyLargeCnt As Long
	Dim lngSaveErrCnt As Long
	Dim lngSetErrCnt As Long
	Dim strType As String
	Dim intReturn As Integer
	Dim blnSetErrFlg As Boolean
	fncInputDataReplace = -1
	lngDcCnt = objBaseDBInfo.SelectDocCnt
	strType = objDataSetPreparation.SetTypeInfo
	If objDataSetPreparation.AllSetFlg = True Then
		Select Case strType
		Case "!A"
			For lngCopyCnt = 1 To objDataSetPreparation.CustomData.Values(0)
				Call objDataSetPreparation.AllDocCopyDel( 1, objBaseDBInfo.SelectDoc )
			Next
		Case "!C"
			Call objDataSetPreparation.AllDocCopyDel( 1, objBaseDBInfo.SelectDoc )
		Case "!D"
			Call objDataSetPreparation.AllDocCopyDel( 2, objBaseDBInfo.SelectDoc )
		Case "!M"
			Call objDataSetPreparation.AllDocCopyDel( 3, objBaseDBInfo.SelectDoc )
		Case Else
			Call objDataSetPreparation.AllDocChangeValue( objBaseDBInfo.SelectDoc )
		End Select
		lngSaveErrCnt = 0
		lngSetErrCnt = 0
	Else
		For lngLoop = 1 To lngDcCnt
			blnSetErrFlg = False
			Set docTarget = objBaseDBInfo.fncReturnDocNth( lngLoop )
			If ( lngLoop Mod 250 ) = 0 Then
				If ( lngLoop + 249 ) > lngDcCnt Then
					lngLargeCnt = lngDcCnt
				Else
					lngLargeCnt = lngLoop + 249
				End If
				Print Cstr( lngLoop ) & "～" & Cstr( lngLargeCnt ) & "件を処理中・・・"_
				& "全件数：" & Cstr( lngDcCnt ) & "件"
			Else
			End If
			If objDataSetPreparation.LogFlg = False Then
			Else
				intReturn = fncFieldDataLog( docTarget, Split( objDataSetPreparation.FName, ";" ) )
				If intReturn = 0 Then
				Else
					blnSetErrFlg = True
				End If
			End If
			Select Case strType
			Case "A"
				Call objDataSetPreparation.AddValue( docTarget )
			Case "F"
				Call objDataSetPreparation.SetFormat( docTarget, lngLoop )
			Case "@"
				intReturn = objDataSetPreparation.fncExecuteMacro( docTarget )
				If intReturn = 0 Then
				Else
					blnSetErrFlg = True
				End If
			Case "!A"
				lngCopyLargeCnt = 0
				For lngCopyCnt = 1 To objDataSetPreparation.CustomData.Values(0)
					If ( lngCopyCnt Mod 250 ) = 0 Then
						If ( lngCopyCnt + 249 ) > objDataSetPreparation.CustomData.Values(0) Then
							lngCopyLargeCnt = objDataSetPreparation.CustomData.Values(0)
						Else
							lngCopyLargeCnt = lngCopyCnt + 249
						End If
						Print Cstr( lngLoop ) & "件目 ⇒ " & Cstr( lngCopyCnt ) & "～" & Cstr( lngCopyLargeCnt ) & "件を増殖中・・・"_
						& "増殖件数：" & Cstr( objDataSetPreparation.CustomData.Values(0) ) & "件"
					Else
					End If
					intReturn = objDataSetPreparation.fncDocCopyDel( 1, docTarget )
					If intReturn = 0 Then
					Else
						lngSaveErrCnt = lngSaveErrCnt + 1
						Exit For
					End If
				Next
			Case "!C"
				intReturn = objDataSetPreparation.fncDocCopyDel( 1, docTarget )
				If intReturn = 0 Then
				Else
					lngSaveErrCnt = lngSaveErrCnt + 1
				End If
			Case "!D"
				intReturn = objDataSetPreparation.fncDocCopyDel( 2, docTarget )
				If intReturn = 0 Then
				Else
					lngSaveErrCnt = lngSaveErrCnt + 1
				End If
			Case "!M"
				intReturn = objDataSetPreparation.fncDocCopyDel( 3, docTarget )
				If intReturn = 0 Then
				Else
					lngSaveErrCnt = lngSaveErrCnt + 1
				End If
			Case "!R"
				If docTarget.ComputeWithForm( False, False ) = False Then
					blnSetErrFlg = True
				Else
				End If
			Case Else
				intReturn = objDataSetPreparation.ChangeValue( docTarget )
				If intReturn = 0 Then
				Else
					blnSetErrFlg = True
				End If
			End Select
			Select Case strType
			Case "!A","!C","!D","!M"
			Case Else
				If blnSetErrFlg = False Then
					If docTarget.Save( False, False ) = False Then
						lngSaveErrCnt = lngSaveErrCnt + 1
					End If
				Else
					lngSetErrCnt = lngSetErrCnt + 1
				End If
			End Select
		Next
	End If
	Call EndMsgDisp( strType, lngDcCnt, lngSaveErrCnt, lngSetErrCnt )
	Select Case strType
	Case "!D", "!M"
		fncInputDataReplace = 1
		Exit Function
	Case Else
	End Select
	fncInputDataReplace = 0
	Exit Function
ERR_HANDLE:
	fncInputDataReplace = -1
	Call OnErrorMsgDisp( "fncInputDataReplace関数", Erl, Err, Error$ )
	Exit Function
End Function

Function KeywordListReturn( strKeyIndex As String ) As Variant

		Case "S"

		Case "D"

		Case "N"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "N：数値(Numberの略);"
		Case "V"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "V：NULL(Voidの略);"
		Case "R"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "R：リッチテキスト(RichTextの略);"
		Case "U"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "U：値の検索・置換(Updateの略);"

			strKeySet = strKeySet & "A：値の追加(Appendの略);"
		Case "E"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "E：フィールドの消去(Eraseの略);"
		Case "F"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "F：形式指定(Formatの略);"
		Case "S[N]"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "S[N]：名前属性(Namesの略);"
		Case "S[NR]"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "S[NR]：読者名属性(Names・Readersの略);"
		Case "S[NA]"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "S[NA]：作成者名属性(Names・Authorsの略);"
		Case "V-D"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "V-D：日付/時刻属性のNULL;"
		Case "V-R"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "V-R：リッチテキスト属性のNULL;"
		Case "S[NRA]"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "S[NRA]：読者名+作成者名属性;"
		Case "V[NRA]"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "V[NRA]：読者名+作成者名属性NULL;"
		Case "V[N]"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "V[N]：名前属性NULL;"
		Case "V[NR]"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "V[NR]：読者名属性NULL;"
		Case "V[NA]"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "V[NA]：作成者名属性NULL;"
		Case "C"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "C：属性変更(Changeの略);"
		Case "[N]"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "[N]：属性変更<名前>;"
		Case "[NR]"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "[NR]：属性変更<読者名>;"
		Case "[NA]"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "[NA]：属性変更<作成者名>;"
		Case "[NRA]"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "[NRA]：属性変更<読者名+作成者名>;"
		Case "Z"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "Z：特殊設定;"
		Case Else
		End Select
	End Forall
	KeywordListReturn = Arrayunique(Fulltrim(Split(strKeySet, ";")))
	Erase vKeyIndex
End Function

End Function

Sub LineTabChange( intChangeType As Integer, strData As String )
	Dim strTmpData As String
	Dim strTmpKey As String
	Dim intLength As Integer
	Dim intSetCnt As Integer
	intLength = Len(strData)
	If intLength = 0 Then
		Exit Sub
	Else
		strTmpData = ""
	End If
	Select Case intChangeType
	Case 0
		For intSetCnt = 1 To intLength
			strTmpKey = Mid(strData, intSetCnt, 1)
			Select Case strTmpKey
			Case Chr(13)
				strTmpData = strTmpData & "~"
				intSetCnt = intSetCnt + 1
			Case Chr(9)
				strTmpData = strTmpData & "|"
			Case Else
				strTmpData = strTmpData & strTmpKey
			End Select
		Next
		strData = strTmpData
	Case 1
		For intSetCnt = 1 To intLength
			strTmpKey = Mid(strData, intSetCnt, 1)
			Select Case strTmpKey
			Case "~"
				strTmpData = strTmpData & Chr(13)&Chr(10)
			Case "|"
				strTmpData = strTmpData & Chr(9)
			Case Else
				strTmpData = strTmpData & strTmpKey
			End Select
		Next
		strData = strTmpData
	Case Else
	End Select
End Sub

Function RichReplace( strResult As String, varRText As Variant ) As Boolean
	Dim ss As NotesSession
	Dim rtsStyle As NotesRichTextStyle
	Dim strList List As String
	Dim strDat As String
	Dim strSubData As String
	Dim strCode As String
	Dim strEleData As String
	Dim intNum As Integer
	Dim strTmp As String
	Set ss = New NotesSession
	intNum = 1
	RichReplace = False
	strDat = Left( strResult, 1 )
	Set rtsStyle = ss.CreateRichTextStyle( )
	With rtsStyle
		.Bold = False
		.Effects = 0
		.FontSize = 10
		.Italic = False
		.NotesColor = 0
		.NotesFont = 1
		.StrikeThrough = False
		.UnderLine = False
	End With
	Call varRText.AppendStyle( rtsStyle )
	While strDat <> ""
		If strDat = "[" Then
			strCode = Strconv(Mid(strResult, intNum+1, 2), 1+8)
			If ( strCode = "F*" ) Or ( strCode = "E*" ) Then
				intNum = intNum + 3
				strDat = Mid(strResult, intNum, 1)
				Do While True
					Select Case strDat
					Case "","]"
						strList(intNum) = strEleData
						strEleData = ""
						Exit Do
					Case "/"
						strList(intNum) = strEleData
						strEleData = ""
					Case Else
						strEleData = strEleData & strDat
					End Select
					intNum = intNum + 1
					strDat = Mid(strResult, intNum, 1)
				Loop
				Select Case strCode
				Case "F*"
					On Error Goto ELEMENT_ERROR
					Forall tmpDat In strList
						strTmp = Strconv(tmpDat, 1+8)
						If strTmp = "B" Then
							rtsStyle.Bold = True
						Elseif strTmp Like "E:*" Then
							rtsStyle.Effects = Cint(Mid(strTmp, 3))
						Elseif strTmp = "I" Then
							rtsStyle.Italic = True
						Elseif strTmp Like "C:*" Then
							rtsStyle.NotesColor = Cint(Mid(strTmp, 3))
						Elseif strTmp Like "F:*" Then
							rtsStyle.NotesFont = Cint(Mid(strTmp, 3))
						Elseif strTmp = "T" Then
							rtsStyle.StrikeThrough = True
						Elseif strTmp = "U" Then
							rtsStyle.UnderLine = True
						Elseif strTmp Like "S:*" Then
							rtsStyle.FontSize = Cint(Mid(strTmp, 3))
						Else
							Msgbox "属性の設定で入力ミスがあります。" & Chr(13)_
							& "下記の文字列を確認してください。" & Chr(13)&Chr(13)_
							& "[" & strCode & "]の設定  ⇒  入力ミスの属性：『" & strTmp & "』", 16, "InputError"
							Exit Function
						End If
					End Forall
					On Error Goto 0
				Case "E*"
					Forall tmpDat In strList
						strTmp = Strconv(tmpDat, 1+8)
						Select Case strTmp
						Case "D"
							With rtsStyle
								.Bold = False
								.Effects = 0
								.FontSize = 10
								.Italic = False
								.NotesColor = 0
								.NotesFont = 1
								.StrikeThrough = False
								.UnderLine = False
							End With
						Case "B"
							rtsStyle.Bold = False
						Case "E"
							rtsStyle.Effects = 0
						Case "S"
							rtsStyle.FontSize = 10
						Case "I"
							rtsStyle.Italic = False
						Case "C"
							rtsStyle.NotesColor = 0
						Case "F"
							rtsStyle.NotesFont = 1
						Case "T"
							rtsStyle.StrikeThrough = False
						Case "U"
							rtsStyle.UnderLine = False
						Case Else
							Msgbox "属性の設定で入力ミスがあります。" & Chr(13)_
							& "下記の文字列を確認してください。" & Chr(13)&Chr(13)_
							& "[" & strCode & "]の設定  ⇒  入力ミスの属性：『" & strTmp & "』", 16, "InputError"
							Exit Function
						End Select
					End Forall
				Case Else
				End Select
				If strSubData <> "" Then
					Call varRText.AppendText( strSubData )
					strSubData = ""
				End If
				Call varRText.AppendStyle( rtsStyle )
				Erase strList
			Elseif Mid(strResult, intNum+1, 1) = "/" Then
				intNum = intNum + 2
				strDat = Mid(strResult, intNum, 1)
				Do While True
					Select Case strDat
					Case "","]"
						Exit Do
					Case "/"
						strList(intNum) = strEleData
						strEleData = ""
					Case Else
						strEleData = strEleData & strDat
					End Select
					intNum = intNum + 1
					strDat = Mid(strResult, intNum, 1)
				Loop
				If strSubData <> "" Then
					Call varRText.AppendText( strSubData )
					strSubData = ""
				End If
				Forall tmpPath In strList
					On Error 4225 Goto FILE_ERROR
					Call varRText.EmbedObject( EMBED_ATTACHMENT, "", tmpPath )
					On Error Goto 0
				End Forall
				strEleData = ""
				Erase strList
			Else
				Select Case strDat
				Case "~"
					strSubData = strSubData & Chr(13)&Chr(10)
				Case "|"
					strSubData = strSubData & Chr(9)
				Case Else
					strSubData = strSubData & strDat
				End Select
			End If
		Else
			Select Case strDat
			Case "~"
				strSubData = strSubData & Chr(13)&Chr(10)
			Case "|"
				strSubData = strSubData & Chr(9)
			Case Else
				strSubData = strSubData & strDat
			End Select
		End If
		intNum = intNum + 1
		strDat = Mid(strResult, intNum, 1)
	Wend
	If strSubData <> "" Then
		Call varRText.AppendText( strSubData )
	End If
	RichReplace = True
	Exit Function
ELEMENT_ERROR:
	Msgbox "属性の設定で入力ミスがあります。" & Chr(13)_
	& "下記の文字列を確認してください。" & Chr(13)&Chr(13)_
	& "[" & strCode & "]の設定  ⇒  入力ミスの属性：『" & strTmp & "』", 16, "InputError"
	Exit Function
FILE_ERROR:
	Msgbox "ファイル添付時にエラーが発生しました。" & Chr(13)_
	& "指定したファイルが存在しないか、またはパスの入力ミスがありますので" & Chr(13)_
	& "確認後、再度実行してください。", 16, "FileError"
	Exit Function
End Function
Function fncInputCheck( strType As String, strData As String ) As Boolean
	Dim varResult As Variant
	Dim strDataPiece As String
	Dim strPiece As String
	Dim intSetNum As Integer
	fncInputCheck = False
	Select Case strType
	Case "!A"
		If Isnumeric(strData) = False Then
			fncInputCheck = False
		Elseif Clng(strData) <= 0 Then
			fncInputCheck = False
		Elseif Instr(strData, ".") > 0 Then
			fncInputCheck = False
		Else
			fncInputCheck = True
		End If
	Case "U","!C","!M"
		varResult = Split(strData, ";", -1, 5)
		If Ubound(varResult) = 1 Then
			fncInputCheck = True
		Else
			fncInputCheck = False
		End If
		Erase varResult
	Case "N","D"
		strDataPiece = strData
		Do While strDataPiece <> ""
			intSetNum = Instr(strDataPiece,";")
			Select Case intSetNum
			Case 0
				strPiece = strDataPiece
				strDataPiece = ""
			Case 1
				strPiece = "ERROR"
				strDataPiece = ""
			Case Else
				strPiece = Left( strDataPiece, intSetNum-1 )
				strDataPiece = Right( strDataPiece, Len(strDataPiece)-intSetNum )
				If strDataPiece = "" Then
					strPiece = "ERROR"
				End If
			End Select
			If (( strType = "N" ) And ( Isnumeric( strPiece ) = False ))_
			Or (( strType = "D" ) And ( Isdate( strPiece ) = False )) Then
				fncInputCheck = False
				Exit Do
			Else
				fncInputCheck = True
			End If
		Loop
	Case Else
		fncInputCheck = True
	End Select
End Function

Function fncFieldDataLog( docTarget As NotesDocument, varFieldList As Variant ) As Integer
	On Error Goto ERR_HANDLE
	Dim varResult As Variant
	Dim varItem As Variant
	Dim itmLog As NotesItem
	Dim strDataInfo As String
	Dim intDataType As Integer
	fncFieldDataLog = -1
	Forall tmpFName In varFieldList
		Set varItem = docTarget.GetFirstItem( tmpFName )
		strDataInfo = strDataInfo & Chr(13)&Chr(10)&Chr(13)&Chr(10) _
		& "フィールド名：" & tmpFName & Chr(13)&Chr(10)
		If varItem Is Nothing Then
			strDataInfo = strDataInfo & "型：[NOTHING]" & Chr(13)&Chr(10) & "値：[NOTHING]"
		Else
			intDataType = varItem.Type
			strDataInfo = strDataInfo & "型：" & fncGetItemTypeName( intDataType ) & Chr(13)&Chr(10)
			If intDataType = 1 Then
				strDataInfo = strDataInfo & "値：『" & varItem.GetUnformattedText( ) & "』"
			Else
				strDataInfo = strDataInfo & "値：『" & varItem.text & "』"
			End If
		End If
	End Forall
	varResult = Evaluate( {"◆更新時間：" + @Text(@Now([SERVERTIME]:[LOCALTIMEONERROR])) + @Char(0) + "◆更新者ID：" + @Name( [CN]; @UserName )} )
	strDataInfo = varResult(0) & strDataInfo
	Set itmLog = docTarget.GetFirstItem( "$DataChangeLog$" )
	If itmLog Is Nothing Then
	Else
		strDataInfo = itmLog.text & Chr(13)&Chr(10)&Chr(13)&Chr(10) & strDataInfo
	End If
	Call docTarget.ReplaceItemValue( "$DataChangeLog$", strDataInfo )
	fncFieldDataLog = 0
	Exit Function

	fncFieldDataLog = -1
	Exit Function
End Function
Sub MakeMsg( objDocElement As clsDocElement, varFName As Variant )

	Dim strFName As String
	strMsg = "フィールド名" & Space$(10) & Chr(9) & "型" & Space$(15) & Chr(9) & "値" & Chr(13) & _
	"------------------------------------------------------------------------" & Chr(13)

			strFName = Left( tmpFName, 15 ) & "･･･"
		Else
			strFName = Left( tmpFName & Space$( 15 ), 15 )
		End If
		If objDocElement.FValue Is Nothing Then
			strMsg = strMsg & strFName & Chr(9) & "[NOTHING]" & Chr(13)
		Else
			Call objDocElement.GetFInfo( Cstr( tmpFName ), 1 )
			If objDocElement.FProperty = 1 Then
				strFValue = objDocElement.FValue.GetUnFormattedText( )
			Else
				strFValue = objDocElement.FValue.text
			End If
			If  Len( strFValue ) > 20 Then
				strFValue = Left( strFValue, 20 ) & "･･･"
			Else
			End If
			Call LineTabChange( 0, strFValue )
			strMsg = strMsg & strFName & Chr(9) & _
			Left( fncGetItemTypeName( objDocElement.FProperty ) & Space$( 15 ), 15 ) & Chr(9) _
			& "『" & strFValue & "』" & Chr(13)

Sub EndMsgDisp( strType As String, lngDcCnt As Long, _
lngSaveErrCnt As Long, lngSetErrCnt As Long )
	Dim strEndMsg As String
	Dim strReplaceWord As String
	Select Case strType
	Case "E"
		strEndMsg = "フィールド#消去"
	Case "!A"
		strEndMsg = "文書#増殖"
	Case "!C"
		strEndMsg = "文書#コピー"
	Case "!D"
		strEndMsg = "文書#削除"
	Case "!M"
		strEndMsg = "文書#移動"
	Case "!R"
		strEndMsg = "文書#更新"
	Case Else
		strEndMsg = "データ#設定"
	End Select
	If ( lngSaveErrCnt > 0 ) Or ( lngSetErrCnt > 0 ) Then
		strReplaceWord = "の"
	Else
		strReplaceWord = "を"
	End If
	strEndMsg = Strleft(strEndMsg, "#") & strReplaceWord & Strrightback(strEndMsg, "#")
	If ( lngSaveErrCnt > 0 ) Or ( lngSetErrCnt > 0 ) Then
		Select Case strType
		Case "E","!A","!C","!D","!M"
			If lngDcCnt = 1 Then
				Msgbox strEndMsg & "に失敗しました。", 48, "ERROR"
			Else
				Msgbox Cstr(lngDcCnt) & "件中" & Cstr(lngSaveErrCnt) & "件の文書が"_
				& strEndMsg & "に失敗しました。", 48, "ERROR"
			End If
		Case Else
			If lngDcCnt = 1 Then
				If lngSaveErrCnt > 0 Then
					Msgbox "文書を保存できませんでした。", 48, "ERROR"
				Else
					Msgbox strEndMsg & "に失敗しました。", 48, "ERROR"
				End If
			Else
				Msgbox Cstr(lngDcCnt) & "件中" & Cstr(lngSetErrCnt) & "件の文書が"_
				& strEndMsg & "に失敗し、" & Chr(13)_
				& Cstr(lngSaveErrCnt) & "件が保存できませんでした。", 48, "ERROR"
			End If
		End Select
	Else
		Msgbox strEndMsg & "しました。", 64, "変更終了"
	End If
End Sub20111003T165402,60+09

    Function funcEigyobiGet(strMotoDay As String, intAddNissu As Integer) As String
    	Dim ss As NotesSession
    	Dim dbCur As NotesDatabase
    	Dim viwSyuku As NotesView
    	Dim docSyuku As NotesDocument
    	Dim DtmTime As NotesDateTime
    	Dim varSyukuDay As Variant
    	Dim strChkDay As String
    	Dim intCount As Integer
    	Dim intAdd As Integer
    	On Error Goto ERR_HANDLE
    	intCount = 1
    	intAdd = 1
    	If Isdate(strMotoDay) = False Then
    		funcEigyobiGet = ""
    		Exit Function
    	Elseif intAddNissu = 0 Then
    		funcEigyobiGet = strMotoDay

    	Do While intCount <= Abs(intAddNissu)

Function funcPutExecLog(docLog As NotesDocument, intErrLevel As Integer, strExecResult As String) As Boolean
%REM ********************************************************************
		目的		：	エージェントの処理内容を書き出す。
		引数		：	docLog			⇒　エージェントログ書き出し先文書
						intErrLevel		⇒　処理結果
											0 … 正常処理
											1 … エラーロジックにおけるエラー
											2 … オンエラーにおけるエラー
						strExecResult　⇒　処理結果
		
		戻り値		：	ログ書き出し成功　⇒　True
						ログ書き出し失敗　⇒　False
		備考		：	
		変更履歴	：	2006/04/10  FSI　井月　新規作成 
%END REM ****************************************************************
	
	'変数の宣言
	Dim strTempResult 	As String
	Dim intBeforeStatus 	As Integer
	Dim intErrorStatus 		As Integer
	
	
	'エラーハンドル
	On Error Goto ERROR_HANDLE 
	
	
	
	
	'処理開始
	
	'初期値設定
	funcPutExecLog 	= False
	intBeforeStatus 	= 0
	intErrorStatus 		= intErrLevel
	strTempResult 		= strExecResult
	
	
	'不正な引数をチェック
	If (intErrLevel < 0) Or (2< intErrLevel) Then
		intErrorStatus = 2
		strTempResult = strTempResult & Chr(13) & Chr(10) &_
		"funcPutExecLog関数の引数（intErrLevel）に不正な値が渡されました。"
	Else
		'処理続行
		
	'処理結果アイテムがあるかチェック（新規作成文書にはアイテムがない）
		If docLog.HasItem( "ResultStatus" ) = True Then
			intBeforeStatus = docLog.ResultStatus(0)
		End If
		
	'前回処理を行っていない場合か、前回エラーレベルよりも今回エラーレベルが高い場合
		If (intBeforeStatus =< intErrLevel ) Then
		'結果ステータスを後続処理にて上書きするためにそのまま処理続行
			
	'今回エラーレベルよりも前回エラーレベルが高い場合
		Elseif(intBeforeStatus > intErrLevel) Then
		'エラーレベルが高いほうの結果を残すための処理
			intErrorStatus = intBeforeStatus
			
		Else
		'その他　処理続行
			
		End If
		
		
	End If
	
	'処理結果を書き出し
	With docLog
		.ResultStatus 	= intErrorStatus
		.ExecResult 	= .ExecResult(0) & Chr(13) & Chr(10) & strTempResult & Chr(13) & Chr(10)
		.ExecEndDate 	= Now
	End With
	
	Call docLog.Save(True, True)
	funcPutExecLog = True
	
	Exit Function
	
'エラー処理	
ERROR_HANDLE:
	
	funcPutExecLog = False	
	
	'エラーメッセージをLog.nsfに書き出す
	Print funcOnErrorMsg("funcPutExecLog", Err, Erl, Error$)
	
	Exit Function
	
End Function
Function funcEigyobiGet(strMotoDay As String, intAddNissu As Integer) As String
%REM  ◆営業日取得
◆作成日：2006/04/14
◆作成者：FSI sasaki
◆概要
	基準日から○○日後の営業日を戻り値として返す。
	営業日は土日および祝日設定の日数を除いた日数で計算する。
◆引数：
	strMotoDay・・・YYYY/MM/DD形式の文字列で基準日を渡す
	intAddNissu・・・基準日に追加する日数。0の場合、元の日付とする
			マイナスの場合、過去日付となる。
◆戻り値：
	YYYY/MM/DD形式の日付
	エラーの場合は空データを返す

%END REM
	Dim ss As NotesSession
	Dim dbCur As NotesDatabase
	Dim viwSyuku As NotesView
	Dim docSyuku As NotesDocument
	Dim DtmTime As NotesDateTime
	Dim varSyukuDay As Variant
	Dim strChkDay As String
	Dim intCount As Integer
	Dim intAdd As Integer
	
	On Error Goto ERR_HANDLE
	
	
	'☆初期化
	intCount = 1
	intAdd = 1
	
	If Isdate(strMotoDay) = False Then
		funcEigyobiGet = ""
		Exit Function
	Elseif intAddNissu = 0 Then
		funcEigyobiGet = strMotoDay
		Exit Function
	Elseif intAddNissu < 0 Then
		'追加日数をマイナスにする
		intAdd = -1
	Else
		'処理を続行
	End If
	
	Set ss = New NotesSession
	
	Set dbCur = ss.CurrentDatabase
	Set viwSyuku = dbCur.GetView("viwSyukuCalendar")
	Set docSyuku = viwSyuku.GetFirstDocument
	If docSyuku Is Nothing Then
		varSyukuDay = Split("")
	Else
		varSyukuDay = docSyuku.SyukuDay
	End If
	
	Set DtmTime = New NotesDateTime( strMotoDay )
	
	Do While intCount <= Abs(intAddNissu)
		Call DtmTime.AdjustDay( intAdd )
		strChkDay = DtmTime.DateOnly
		If (Weekday(strChkDay) = 1) Or (Weekday(strChkDay) = 7) Then
			'休日のため、カウントしない
			
		Elseif Isnull(Arraygetindex( varSyukuDay, strChkDay )) = False Then
			'休日のため、カウントしない
			
		Else
			intCount = intCount + 1
		End If
		
	Loop
	
	funcEigyobiGet = DtmTime.DateOnly
	
	Exit Function
	
ERR_HANDLE:
	
	funcEigyobiGet = ""
	
	Exit Function
	
End Function

- funcWfStatGet
  Signature: Function funcWfStatGet(strStatusCode As String, intExecFlag As Integer) As Variant
  Parameters: strStatusCode As String, intExecFlag As Integer
  Purpose: ：	進捗コードに対応する進捗名称を取得する
  Return: ：	funcWorkflowStatGet(0)	進捗コード
  Remarks: ：	不正な進捗コードが入力された場合は、戻り値にデータをセットしない。
  History: ：	2005/05/31 FSI.Fukuchi 新規作成
  Source:
    Function funcWfStatGet(strStatusCode As String, intExecFlag As Integer) As Variant
    	Dim intMaxCount As Integer
    	Dim strWorkflowStatus(1,7) As String
    	intMaxCount = 7
    	strWorkflowStatus(0,0) = "1000"
    	strWorkflowStatus(1,0) = "起案中"
    	strWorkflowStatus(0,1) = "2000"
    	strWorkflowStatus(1,1) = "役付承認待ち"
    	strWorkflowStatus(0,2) = "2500"
    	strWorkflowStatus(1,2) = "役付承認済"
    	strWorkflowStatus(0,3) = "3000"
    	strWorkflowStatus(1,3) = "依頼送付済"
    	strWorkflowStatus(0,4) = "4000"
    	strWorkflowStatus(1,4) = "受付済"
    	strWorkflowStatus(0,5) = "5000"
    	strWorkflowStatus(1,5) = "回答作成中"
    	strWorkflowStatus(0,6) = "6000"
    	strWorkflowStatus(1,6) = "回答送信済"
    	strWorkflowStatus(0,7) = "7000"
    	strWorkflowStatus(1,7) = "回答確認済"
    	Dim strTempWorkflowStatus(1,2) As String
    	Dim strReturnData(1) As String
    	Dim intCount As Integer
    	funcWfStatGet = ""
    	For intCount = 0 To intMaxCount
    		If strWorkflowStatus(0,intCount) = strStatusCode Then
    			strTempWorkflowStatus(0,0) = strWorkflowStatus(0,intCount)
    			strTempWorkflowStatus(1,0) = strWorkflowStatus(1,intCount)
    			If intCount < intMaxCount Then
    				strTempWorkflowStatus(0,1) = strWorkflowStatus(0,intCount + 1)
    				strTempWorkflowStatus(1,1) = strWorkflowStatus(1,intCount + 1)
    			End If
    			If intCount > 0 Then
    				strTempWorkflowStatus(0,2) = strWorkflowStatus(0,intCount - 1)
    				strTempWorkflowStatus(1,2) = strWorkflowStatus(1,intCount - 1)
    			End If
    			Exit For
    		End If
    	Next
    	strReturnData(0) = strTempWorkflowStatus(0,intExecFlag)
    	strReturnData(1) = strTempWorkflowStatus(1,intExecFlag)
    	funcWfStatGet = strReturnData
    End Function

  Return: ◆戻り値：
  History: ◆変更履歴：

  Source:
    Function funcAgeReturn( strBirthDay As String, strDefDate As String ) As Integer
    	Dim dtmBirthDay As NotesDateTime
    	Dim dtmDefDate As NotesDateTime
    	Dim dtmTmpDate As NotesDateTime
    	Dim dblAgeSecond As Double
    	Dim intYearDef As Integer
    	If Isdate(strBirthDay) = False Then
    		funcAgeReturn = -1
    		Exit Function
    	Else
    		Set dtmBirthDay = New NotesDateTime( strBirthDay )
    		Set dtmTmpDate = New NotesDateTime( strBirthDay )
    	End If
    	If strDefDate = "" Then
    		Set dtmDefDate = New NotesDateTime( "Today" )
    	Else
    		If Isdate(strDefDate) = False Then
    			funcAgeReturn = -1
    			Exit Function
    		Else
    			Set dtmDefDate = New NotesDateTime( strDefDate )
    		End If
    	End If
    	dblAgeSecond = dtmDefDate.TimeDifferenceDouble( dtmBirthDay )
    	If dblAgeSecond < 0 Then
    		funcAgeReturn = -1
    	Else
    		intYearDef = Year(dtmDefDate.DateOnly) - Year(dtmBirthDay.DateOnly)
    		Call dtmTmpDate.AdjustYear(intYearDef)
    		dblAgeSecond = dtmDefDate.TimeDifferenceDouble( dtmTmpDate )
    		If dblAgeSecond < 0 Then
    			funcAgeReturn = intYearDef - 1
    		Else
    			funcAgeReturn = intYearDef
    		End If
    	End If
    End Function

Option Declare

Function funcUpdateRireki(doc As NotesDocument, strStatusCode As String) As Boolean
%REM ********************************************************************
  目的	：	履歴を更新し、ステータス更新者情報を設定する
  引数	：	doc 	(IN/OUT) 	更新対象の文書
			strStatusCode 更新履歴に設定する進捗のコード
  戻り値：	エラー情報（Boolean型）
  備考	：	本関数内ではSaveされない

			以下のフィールドが作成／更新される
			・更新日時（fKousinDate）
			・更新者組織名称（fSyozoku）
			・更新者（fKousinsya）
			・更新後の進捗（fKousinStatus）

  変更履歴：	2006/05/30 DLS.Chida 新規作成
				2006/06/19 FSI sasaki 進捗コードの引数追加
%END REM ****************************************************************
	On Error Goto ERR_TRAP
	
	Dim objAddressInfo 	As clsAddressInfo	'カレントユーザーの漢字アドレス帳情報取得
	Dim varRirekiDate		As Variant			'履歴の更新日（配列）
	Dim varRirekiKikan		As Variant			'履歴の所属（配列）
	Dim varRirekiName		As Variant			'履歴の更新者（配列）
	Dim varRirekiStatus	As Variant			'履歴のステータス（配列）
	Dim varNow 			As Variant			'現在の日時
	Dim varStatusRet		As Variant			'funcWfStatGet関数の戻り値
	Dim strDate			As String			'更新日
	Dim strKikan			As String			'所属
	Dim strName			As String			'更新者
	'Dim strStatusCode		As String			'ステータスNo  '2006/06/19 FSI sasaki・・・引数で取得するように変更
	Dim strStatusName	As String			'ステータス名
	Dim strRetMsg			As String			'funcReturnMsgにて返ってきたメッセージ
	Dim blnSEM			As String			'エラー情報
	
	'初期値
	funcUpdateRireki = True
	
	'カレントユーザーのアドレス帳情報取得
	Set objAddressInfo = New clsAddressInfo("")
	
	'漢字アドレス帳から情報を取得できなかった場合=False
	If objAddressInfo.InfoFlag = False Then
		strRetMsg = funcReturnMsg( "E019" )
		Msgbox strRetMsg, 0 + 16, "システムエラー"
		
		funcUpdateRireki = False
		Exit Function
	End If
	
	With doc
		'既存の履歴を取得
		varRirekiDate = .KousinDate
		varRirekiKikan = .KousinSosiki
		varRirekiName = .Kousinsya
		varRirekiStatus = .KousinStatus
	End With
	
	'--------------------------------------------------------------------
	'①サーバーから現在の日時を取得
	'--------------------------------------------------------------------
	Call fncGetServerTime(varNow)			'ScriptLibrary-libCommon
	strDate = Format$(varNow, "yyyy/mm/dd hh:nn:ss")
	
	
	'--------------------------------------------------------------------
	'②機関名を取得
	'--------------------------------------------------------------------
	strKikan = objAddressInfo.HIGDeptName & "　" & objAddressInfo.MDLDeptName
	
	
	'--------------------------------------------------------------------
	'③現在のユーザー氏名を取得
	'--------------------------------------------------------------------
	strName = objAddressInfo.KnjName
	
	
	'--------------------------------------------------------------------
	'④ステータス名を取得
	'--------------------------------------------------------------------
	'strStatusCode = doc.StatusCode(0)  '2006/06/19 FSI sasaki・・・引数で取得するように変更
	
	'★現在の進捗コードとステータスを返す
	varStatusRet = funcWfStatGet( strStatusCode, 0 )
	
	'戻り値がNull = システムエラー
	If varStatusRet(0) = "" Then
		
		'関数内でエラーメッセージを返していないため、ここでメッセージ表示
		strRetMsg = funcReturnMsg( "E021" )	
		Msgbox strRetMsg, 0 + 16, "エラー"	
		
		funcUpdateRireki = False
		
			'オブジェクトの開放
		Set objAddressInfo = Nothing
		Exit Function
	End If
	
	
	'--------------------------------------------------------------------
	'⑤履歴の更新に値をセット
	'--------------------------------------------------------------------	
	'既存の履歴有無を判定し、既に存在する場合は最後に追加する
	If varRirekiDate(0) = "" Then
		
		'履歴を新規に設定
		varRirekiDate = strDate
		varRirekiKikan = strKikan
		varRirekiName = strName
		varRirekiStatus = varStatusRet(1)
	Else
		'履歴を更新
		varRirekiDate = Arrayappend(varRirekiDate, strDate)
		varRirekiKikan = Arrayappend(varRirekiKikan, strKikan)
		varRirekiName = Arrayappend(varRirekiName, strName)
		varRirekiStatus = Arrayappend(varRirekiStatus, varStatusRet(1))
	End If
	
	'値をフィールドにセット
	doc.KousinDate		= varRirekiDate
	doc.KousinSosiki	= varRirekiKikan
	doc.Kousinsya		= varRirekiName
	doc.KousinStatus	= varRirekiStatus
	
	'オブジェクトの開放
	Set objAddressInfo = Nothing
	
	Exit Function
	
ERR_TRAP:
	funcUpdateRireki = False
	
	strRetMsg = funcReturnMsg( "E020" )
	
	Msgbox strRetMsg & Chr(13) & Chr(10) & Chr(13) & Chr(10) & _
	funcOnErrorMsg("funcUpdateRireki",Err, Erl, Error$), 16, "システムエラー"	
	
	'オブジェクトの開放
	Set objAddressInfo = Nothing
	
	Exit Function
	
End Function
Function funcChkEditDoc ( strStatusCode As String, blnRet As Boolean ) As Boolean
%REM ****************************************************************
		目的		：指定したステータスで文書の編集可否を判定
		引数		：	strStatusCode	(IN)		ステータス番号
			   			blnRet	(OUT)	True = 編集可能
										False = 編集不可
		戻り値		：	関数内エラー情報

		備考		：	[DanTanto]、[ImuUke]、[ImuSyai]ロールで編集可否を判定

		変更履歴	：	2005/05/30 DLS.Chida 新規作成
%END REM ***********************************************************
	
	On Error Goto ERR_TRAP
	
	Dim strRetMsg		As String		'funcReturnMsgにて返ってきたメッセージ
	Dim blnRetCd		As Boolean		'[funcChkUserRoles]関数の戻り値
	Dim blnSEM		As Boolean		'［funcChkEditDoc］関数のエラー情報
	
	'初期値
	blnRet = False
	funcChkEditDoc = True
	
	
	'ステータスとロールで編集可否判定
	
	'ステータスNoが"1000","2000","6000"の場合
	Select Case strStatusCode
	Case "1000","2000","6000"
		'［DanTanto］ロールの有無をチェック→あれば編集可
		blnSEM = funcChkUserRoles ( "[DanTanto]", blnRetCd )	'ScriptLibrary-libCommon
		If blnSEM = False Then
			Exit Function
		Else
			'[funcChkUserRoles]関数の戻り値がFalseだった場合は編集不可
			If blnRetCd = False Then
			'何もしない
			Else
				blnRet = True
				Exit Function
			End If
		End If
		
		
	'ステータスNoが"3000"の場合
		'⇒誰にも編集権がない為、判定は不要
		
		
		
	'ステータスNoが"5000"の場合
	Case "5000"
		'［ImuSyai］ロールの有無をチェック→あれば編集可
		blnSEM = funcChkUserRoles ( "[ImuSyai]", blnRetCd )	'ScriptLibrary-libCommon
		If blnSEM = False Then
			Exit Function
		Else
			'[funcChkUserRoles]関数の戻り値がFalseだった場合は編集不可
			If blnRetCd = False Then
			'何もしない
			Else
				blnRet = True
				Exit Function

Function funcWfStatGet(strStatusCode As String, intExecFlag As Integer) As Variant
%REM ****************************************************************
		目的		：	進捗コードに対応する進捗名称を取得する
		引数		：	strStatusCode	(IN)		進捗コード
						intExecFlag	(IN)		処理区分
												0 : 進捗コードに対応する進捗名称
												1 : 進捗コードの次の進捗名称
												2 : 進捗コードの前の進捗名称
		戻り値		：	funcWorkflowStatGet(0)	進捗コード
						funcWorkflowStatGet(1)	進捗名称
		備考		：	不正な進捗コードが入力された場合は、戻り値にデータをセットしない。
		変更履歴	：	2005/05/31 FSI.Fukuchi 新規作成
%END REM ************************************************************
	
	'*** ワークフロー定義 ***
	
	Dim intMaxCount As Integer
	Dim strWorkflowStatus(1,7) As String '*** 進捗追加時修正 ***
	
	intMaxCount = 7	'*** 進捗追加時修正 ***
	
	strWorkflowStatus(0,0) = "1000"
	strWorkflowStatus(1,0) = "起案中"
	strWorkflowStatus(0,1) = "2000"
	strWorkflowStatus(1,1) = "役付承認待ち"
	strWorkflowStatus(0,2) = "2500"
	strWorkflowStatus(1,2) = "役付承認済"
	strWorkflowStatus(0,3) = "3000"
	strWorkflowStatus(1,3) = "依頼送付済"
	strWorkflowStatus(0,4) = "4000"
	strWorkflowStatus(1,4) = "受付済"
	strWorkflowStatus(0,5) = "5000"
	strWorkflowStatus(1,5) = "回答作成中"
	strWorkflowStatus(0,6) = "6000"
	strWorkflowStatus(1,6) = "回答送信済"
	strWorkflowStatus(0,7) = "7000"
	strWorkflowStatus(1,7) = "回答確認済"	
	
	Dim strTempWorkflowStatus(1,2) As String
	Dim strReturnData(1) As String
	Dim intCount As Integer
	
	'*** 初期処理 ***
	funcWfStatGet = ""
	
	'*** 進捗コード、進捗名称取得 ***
	For intCount = 0 To intMaxCount
		If strWorkflowStatus(0,intCount) = strStatusCode Then
			'*** 進捗コードに対応する進捗コード、進捗名称の取得 ***
			strTempWorkflowStatus(0,0) = strWorkflowStatus(0,intCount)
			strTempWorkflowStatus(1,0) = strWorkflowStatus(1,intCount)
			'*** 進捗コードの次の進捗コード、進捗名称の取得 ***
			If intCount < intMaxCount Then
				strTempWorkflowStatus(0,1) = strWorkflowStatus(0,intCount + 1)
				strTempWorkflowStatus(1,1) = strWorkflowStatus(1,intCount + 1)
			End If
			'*** 進捗コードの前の進捗コード、進捗名称の取得 ***
			If intCount > 0 Then
				strTempWorkflowStatus(0,2) = strWorkflowStatus(0,intCount - 1)
				strTempWorkflowStatus(1,2) = strWorkflowStatus(1,intCount - 1)
			End If
			
			Exit For
		End If
	Next
	
	'*** 処理区分別の戻り値のセット ***
	strReturnData(0) = strTempWorkflowStatus(0,intExecFlag)
	strReturnData(1) = strTempWorkflowStatus(1,intExecFlag)
	funcWfStatGet = strReturnData
	
End Function
Function funcAgeReturn( strBirthDay As String, strDefDate As String ) As Integer
%REM  ◆生年月日から年齢を計算
◆作成日：2006/06/02
◆作成者：FSI sasaki
◆概要
	生年月日を引数に現在の年齢を計算する。
	比較日付を設定した場合は比較日付時点での年齢を返す。
◆引数：
	strBirthDay・・・生年月日
	strDefDate・・・設定した日付時点での年齢を計算するための比較日付
		空データの場合は現在日付時点の年齢を計算する
◆戻り値：
	年齢をInteger型で返す。
	引数が指定した形式ではない場合、エラーが発生した場合は「-1」を返す。
	比較日付が生年月日より過去日付の場合は「-1」を返す。
◆変更履歴：
	2006/06/15 FSI sasaki・・・日付比較処理でオーバーフローしていたため、処理を修正
%END REM
	
	Dim dtmBirthDay As NotesDateTime	'生年月日用
	Dim dtmDefDate As NotesDateTime	'比較日付用
	Dim dtmTmpDate As NotesDateTime	'日付のみ差分を調べるためのオブジェクト
	Dim dblAgeSecond As Double	'日付比較用一時保存変数
	Dim intYearDef As Integer	'年数の差分
	
	'◇生年月日が日付形式かどうか判定
	If Isdate(strBirthDay) = False Then
		funcAgeReturn = -1
		Exit Function
	Else
		'生年月日をオブジェクトに設定
		Set dtmBirthDay = New NotesDateTime( strBirthDay )
		'日付の差分判定用オブジェクトにも同じ日付を設定
		Set dtmTmpDate = New NotesDateTime( strBirthDay )
	End If
	
	
	'◇比較日付が日付形式かどうか判定
	If strDefDate = "" Then
		'現在日付をオブジェクトに設定
		Set dtmDefDate = New NotesDateTime( "Today" )
	Else
		If Isdate(strDefDate) = False Then
			funcAgeReturn = -1
			Exit Function
		Else
			'比較日付をオブジェクトに設定
			Set dtmDefDate = New NotesDateTime( strDefDate )
		End If
	End If
	
	
	'◇生年月日と比較日付を元に年齢を計算
	dblAgeSecond = dtmDefDate.TimeDifferenceDouble( dtmBirthDay )
	If dblAgeSecond < 0 Then
		'比較日付が生年月日より過去の場合はエラー
		funcAgeReturn = -1
	Else
		'年数のみ比較し、その後日付部分を比較
		'最終的に年齢を算出する
		intYearDef = Year(dtmDefDate.DateOnly) - Year(dtmBirthDay.DateOnly)
		Call dtmTmpDate.AdjustYear(intYearDef)
		dblAgeSecond = dtmDefDate.TimeDifferenceDouble( dtmTmpDate )
		If dblAgeSecond < 0 Then
			funcAgeReturn = intYearDef - 1
		Else
			funcAgeReturn = intYearDef
		End If
	End If
	
	
	
End Function

%REM ****************************************************************
		目的		：	生年月日（Birthday）に日付型以外の値が入った場合に
						システムエラーとなって文書が閉じるのを防ぐ対応

Sub Initialize
	On Error Goto ERR_HANDLE
	Dim ss As NotesSession
	Dim dbCur As NotesDatabase
	Dim agFlag As NotesAgent
	Dim viwConflict As NotesView
	Dim dcConflict As NotesDocumentCollection
	Dim docConflict As NotesDocument
	Dim itmDelDate As NotesItem
	Dim dtmTime As NotesDateTime
	Dim docLog As NotesDocument
	Dim strAgName As String
	Dim varServer As Variant
	varServer = Evaluate("@Name([ABBREVIATE];@ServerName)")
	Set ss = New  NotesSession
	Set dbCur = ss.CurrentDatabase
	Set agFlag = ss.CurrentAgent
	strAgName = agFlag.Name
	Set docLog = dbCur.CreateDocument
	docLog.Form = "frmLogDoc"
	Call funcStartExecLog( docLog, varServer(0), strAgName, "D03A 競合文書削除処理")
	Call funcPutExecLog( docLog, 0, "競合文書削除処理開始")
	Call funcPutExecLog( docLog, 0, "対象データ確認開始")
	Set dcConflict = dbCur.UnprocessedDocuments
	If dcConflict.Count = 0 Then
		Call funcPutExecLog( docLog, 0, "対象データなし")
		Call funcPutExecLog( docLog, 0, "競合文書削除処理終了")
		Exit Sub
	Else
		Call funcPutExecLog( docLog, 0, "対象データ数：" & Cstr(dcConflict.Count) & "件")
	End If
	Set dtmTime = New NotesDateTime( "" )
	Call dtmTime.SetNow
	Call funcPutExecLog( docLog, 0, "削除日付設定開始")
	Set docConflict = dcConflict.GetFirstDocument
	Do While Not docConflict Is Nothing
		Set itmDelDate = docConflict.GetFirstItem("DelDate")
		If itmDelDate Is Nothing Then
			Set itmDelDate = New NotesItem( docConflict, "DelDate", dtmTime )
		Else
			Set itmDelDate.DateTimeValue = dtmTime
		End If
		docConflict.DelFlag = 1
		Call docConflict.Save(True, False)
		Set itmDelDate = Nothing
		Set docConflict = dcConflict.GetNextDocument( docConflict )
	Loop
	Call funcPutExecLog( docLog, 0, "削除日付設定終了")
	Call funcPutExecLog( docLog, 0, "削除日付設定処理結果確認")
	Set viwConflict = dbCur.GetView("viwConflict")
	Set docConflict = viwConflict.GetFirstDocument
	If docConflict Is Nothing Then
		Call funcPutExecLog( docLog, 0, "正常終了確認")
	Else
		Call funcPutExecLog( docLog, 1, "処理残文書あり")
	End If
	Call funcPutExecLog( docLog, 0, "競合文書削除処理終了")
	Exit Sub
ERR_HANDLE:
	Call funcPutExecLog(docLog, 2, funcOnErrorMsg( "Initialize", Err, Erl, Error$ ) )
	Exit Sub
